literal_meaning: তাড়াতাড়ি বাঁধা বা গোছানোর শব্দানুকরণ (hurried bundling or packing sound)
similar_in_english: get one's ducks in a row
example_sentences_in_english: Preparations to leave home have started in a hurry.
I'm hustling to arrange the party.
note: Refers to hurried packing, often in rural or travel contexts
